# Foreign overseas trading post (Plan B owned by ROM/BYZ; Plan A transferred to oe_far_exarchate_trade).

    stronger_power_projection = no

    rural_settlement = yes
    town = yes
    city = yes
    megalopolis = yes
    forbidden_for_estates = yes
    build_time = trade_post_build_time
    can_destroy = { always = no }
    country_potential = {
        OR = {
            oe_far_roman_host = yes
            is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate_trade
        }
    }
    location_potential = {
        has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = scope:actor }
    }
    allow = {
        has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = scope:actor }
        has_owner = yes
        owner = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor } }
    }
    remove_if = {
        location = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_variable_list = oe_far_admitted }
                NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = oe_far_admitted target = root.owner } }
            }
        }
    }
    unique_production_methods = {
        oe_far_factoria_upkeep = {
            icon_type = building_type
            icon = trade_office
            paper = 0.05
            category = building_maintenance
        }
    }
    modifier = {
        merchant_capacity_from_building = 0.25
        merchant_power_from_building = 0.25
        local_migration_attraction = 0.1
    }
}
